page: Microsoft Azure E96-24ads_v5 is a constrained-vCPU memory-optimized virtual machine tailored for memory-intensive enterprise workloads that require substantial RAM without paying for unused compute licensing. Built on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, the instance runs on an AMD EPYC 7763 x86_64 processor clocked at 3.525 GHz. It provisions 24 dedicated virtual CPUs across 12 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled, supported by 32 KB L1 data cache, 0.5 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache.

The hardware configuration features 672.0 GB of system memory, providing 28.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Storage architecture includes a bundled 3,865 GB local solid-state drive, eliminating immediate dependencies on external block storage for temporary scratch space, cache arrays, or high-throughput paging. The instance does not include dedicated graphics processing units, relying entirely on the central processor for general compute.

Benchmark evaluations show strong single-core CPU execution alongside high memory subsystem responsiveness, highlighted by top-quartile performance in stress-ng single-core processing (2,905.99) and the PassMark memory benchmark (2,854.45). Multi-core throughput remains in the middle tier with a Geekbench multi-core score of 12,626.0 and stress-ng multi-core rating of 32,377.42. Synthetic database handling registers 10,500.08 operations in PassMark, while Redis reaches 24.26 million SET operations per second. While small language model generation reaches 291.13 tokens per second, large language model prompt evaluation drops to 4.98 tokens per second due to the absence of vector extensions such as AVX-512 and hardware accelerators.

Cost efficiency is centered around software licensing optimization, where high RAM capacity is matched with reduced core counts to minimize per-core licensing expenses. This makes the E96-24ads_v5 ideal for in-memory databases such as SAP HANA or Redis, large relational database management systems, data caching layers, and high-footprint extract, transform, load jobs.
description: Microsoft Azure E96-24ads_v5 is a constrained-vCPU memory-optimized virtual machine designed for applications requiring high memory capacity alongside restricted CPU licensing requirements. Operating on an AMD EPYC 7763 processor at 3.525 GHz, it supplies 24 dedicated virtual CPUs across 12 physical cores and incorporates 672.0 GB of system memory, delivering 28.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. The instance integrates 3,865 GB of local SSD temporary storage with no hardware GPU acceleration. Benchmark assessments highlight strong single-core compute performance and upper-quartile memory throughput in PassMark testing, alongside average multi-core processing speeds and steady caching throughput with Redis yielding 24.26 million operations per second. The server exhibits poor prompt throughput on large 70B language models due to missing AVX-512 instructions, reinforcing its primary suitability for in-memory databases, large-scale caching engines, relational database services, and enterprise transactional systems requiring dense RAM allocations relative to compute cores.
